item.description: Personnel from the Department of Public Works and Highways and the local government unit of Tagum City in Davao del Norte team up to clear a clog of banana trunks at the bottom of the Pagsabangan Bridge II along the Saug River on Saturday afternoon (21 February 2026). item.title: Almost Ready to Swing
item.description: A worker continues setting up the giant swing attraction at Camp Sabros in Kapatagan, Digos City on Saturday (21 February 2026). The ride is expected to open soon as preparations for the park’s newest thrill feature move forward. MindaNews photo by ALLIZAH KEZIAH MANULAT

item.title: Motorbikes on a Truck
item.description: Motorcycles are loaded on the back of a truck owned by the city government of Tagum on Saturday (21 February 2026) so they will not be submerged in floodwaters as rains caused by a shear line continue to inundate many parts of eastern Mindanao. MindaNews photo by GREGORIO C. BUENO
